lines.en: label makotoporngen2:
scene makotonightgen2
I decide to spend the night tormenting Makoto.
lines.zh: 我决定用整晚来折磨 Makoto。

lines.en: And by that I mean I just decide to spend the night with her at work.
lines.zh: 也就是说，我决定整晚陪她上班。

lines.en: Not wanting to put up with me (Which I completely understand), she decides to spend her time playing that game she showed me a while back.
lines.zh: 她不想忍受我（我完全理解），于是决定把时间花在玩她前阵子给我看过的那个游戏上。

lines.en: You know, the one with all the fishing.
lines.zh: 你知道的，那个全是钓鱼的。

lines.en: if bonus == True:
I stop pestering her as I am feeling remarkably generous tonight and, after a while, the two of us are able to carry on a normal conversation that isn't even remotely sexual.
lines.zh: 今晚我出奇地大方，不再烦她，过了一会儿，我俩居然能进行一段正常对话，甚至一点都不带性。

lines.en: That might sound less impressive to you than it does to me, so let me reinforce the idea that I am in a {i}porn shop{/i} right now.
lines.zh: 这在你听来可能没在我听来那么了不起，所以我得强调一下：我现在可是在一家{i}色情用品店{/i}里。

lines.en: Why would I be here if I didn't want to talk about sexual stuff?
lines.zh: 如果我不想聊性的东西，我来这儿干嘛？

lines.en: This epiphany rings out in my head like a church bell and I slowly but surely transition our wholesome conversation into one about how I'd bang every single girl in the game she's playing.
lines.zh: 这个顿悟在我脑子里像教堂钟声一样敲响，我慢慢地、但坚定地把我们这段健康的对话，转成了「我会怎么把她玩的这个游戏里每个女孩都上一遍」。

lines.en: Well, all of them except this one alcoholic nurse.
lines.zh: 嗯，除了那个酗酒的护士。

lines.en: Makoto agrees, but still gets angry either way and yells at me for simply {i}being a human with human thoughts.{/i}
lines.zh: Makoto 同意了，但不管怎样还是生气，冲我大吼，就因为我{i}是一个有人类想法的人类{/i}。

lines.en: else:
I tell her she should just git gud if she wants to catch more fish.
lines.zh: 我告诉她，想钓更多鱼就该「变强点」。

lines.en: Makoto agrees, but still gets angry either way and yells at me for simply {i}being a human with human thoughts.{/i}
lines.zh: Makoto 同意了，但不管怎样还是生气，冲我大吼，就因为我{i}是一个有人类想法的人类{/i}。

lines.en: scene black
The night ends with me being kicked out of the shop.
lines.zh: 这一晚以我被赶出店告终。

lines.en: But at least I manage to snag a new DVD on my way out of the door.
lines.zh: 但至少我在出门时顺走了一张新 DVD。
